correctness.rationale: For odd lengths the integer determinant 2 is nonzero in F5. For even lengths, the 1-dimensional alternating kernel, translated signed-difference forbidden set, closure bijection, finite-character identity and four-subset inclusion-exclusion prove the exact all-n formulas. Edge cases n=2,4,6 are accounted for. Independent brute enumeration n=2..8 and integer identities n=2..201 match. Neither enumeration nor logs are offered as an infinite proof.

originality.rationale: Published scientific-record searches of prime-five cyclic pair sums, proper colorings, mod-field inverse multiplicity and related reconstruction returned nearby but non-dominating work. Full-text primary comparisons distinguish ordered modulo-five local observations with proper-coloring sources from unrestricted linear CA preimage periods, binary local histograms, binary composition multisets, partial-overlap substring coding, and deletion codes. value.rationale: The proper-coloring restriction is a canonical run-length-one finite-alphabet constraint and the local modular sum is a natural lossy nearest-neighbor signal read. At the first odd prime supporting four inverse-list degrees, the theorem provides the full all-length distribution, a five-output maximum ambiguity characterization, exact onset of missing linearly feasible outputs at length six and asymptotically near-certain unique decoding among feasible outputs. These are motivated reconstruction invariants, not isolated arithmetic tests.
